_readme: Machine-local config for CompanionHelper. On EACH machine, copy this file to 'config.local.json' (git-ignored) in the project root and set only the keys that differ there. DELETE any key you do not need to override - a missing key always falls back to the default in core/config.py, so you keep receiving later default changes on git pull. Keys starting with '_' are notes and are ignored. Windows paths: use forward slashes, e.g. 'C:/Program Files (x86)/...' (a single backslash would break JSON). FFS_JOBS is a JSON array of [label, path-to-.ffs_batch] pairs.
_deck: Which Companion page number this machine's physical deck is mapped to, and the Companion OSC endpoint this server writes button visuals to.
_pdq: PDQ Deploy is local-only: these paths point at THIS machine's install (Enterprise license + elevated server needed for deploys).
_touch: TouchDesigner OSC target on this machine (the per-group OSC addresses come from the touch/groups/*.txt files).
_pixelhue: PixelHue Q8 node on this network (default is the venue device; see PIXELHUE_* in core/config.py and PIXELHUE_API_GUIDE.md).
_ffs: FreeFileSync is per-machine: the exe path and which batch jobs belong to this machine. FFS_JOBS is an array of [label, path-to-.ffs_batch] pairs.
